dedupe_keys.name: building data genome directory metadata collection

description: The Building Data Genome Directory is a metadata collection for finding building-performance research data. BUDS Lab and collaborators describe sixty datasets assembled from government, research and public energy sources, covering meter, building and community scales. Categories include building energy and water use, modelling inputs, weather and other building attributes. The GitHub repository contains directory tables and the Streamlit application used to filter and display them. Its geographic and temporal coverage varies by the linked collection; it does not provide one common measured time series or spatial resolution. Public repository access is free under MIT. Each linked dataset retains its own licence, access route and quality limits, which must be checked separately. The reported sixty-item scope was taken from the README and was not independently reconciled with every live destination. Simulation uses include finding calibration observations and model inputs for building-energy studies. It relates to data-building-data-genome-2, but the directory is distinct from that hourly meter dataset. The hosted application and community submission workflow were not executed.
